---
name: RFC
about: Propose a new feature or a larger change before you build it
title: "[RFC] "
labels: rfc/discussion
---

## Summary

The change you propose, in a paragraph.

## Motivation

The problem it solves and who has it.

### Goals

What the change should achieve, and how we will know it worked.

### Non-goals

What is out of scope, to keep the discussion focused.

## Proposal

What the change is, from a user's point of view: new commands, flags, or behavior.

## Design and implementation

How you plan to build it, and the alternatives you considered. Use synthetic examples only.
